slides.headline: Kindling: Print‑and‑Play for Indie Designers
lines: Turning prototype chaos into a streamlined workflow.
slides.notes: Introduce the company and its core mission.

slides.headline: Prototyping eats designers’ evenings
lines: Manual layout leads to mis‑aligned cards and boards.
Playtest notes are scattered across emails and PDFs.
slides.notes: Highlight the pain points indie creators face.

slides.headline: A ready‑to‑print kit and feedback sorter
lines: Templates print perfectly on any home printer.
Digital form auto‑categorises tester comments.
slides.notes: Explain how Kindling solves the outlined problems.

slides.headline: Thousands of solo board‑game creators worldwide
lines: Growing indie game scene fuels demand for low‑cost prototyping.
Kickstarter launches show a steady rise in first‑time designers.
slides.notes: Set the context for market opportunity.

slides.headline: 12 beta users in twelve weeks, 2 already paying
lines: Beta users grew from 2 to 12 since 6 July.
Two designers pay €39 a month: €78 MRR.
40 playtest sessions run on the kit so far.
slides.notes: Every number here is read off the Metrics card, the week of 21 September.
slides.source: Metrics card, kindling-12-weeks.csv, week of 21 Sep

slides.headline: Founder runs design and development
lines: One‑person team combines board‑game design with software skills.
Directly understands user workflow and pain.
slides.notes: Introduce the solo founder and relevant expertise.

slides.headline: Seeking a small angel round
lines: Funding will accelerate feedback‑sorter development and expand template library.
slides.notes: Describe the purpose of the raise without specifying amount.

slides.headline: Current financial snapshot
slides.notes: Show available capital to sustain operations.

slides.headline: "Kindling lets me print a playable prototype fast."
lines: — Beta user, indie designer
slides.notes: Provide a real user voice to validate the solution.

slides.headline: Next milestones for the next 6 months
lines: Launch feedback sorter to all beta users.
Add five new template packs.
Reach five paying customers.
slides.notes: Outline concrete goals to assure investors of progress.
